Description: Ghost Seal: one Nitro Enclaves host per region. The enclave runs the Seal; the host runs only the parent proxy. No SSH, no inbound port but the proxy's, IMDSv2 only, and a role with no KMS, S3, Secrets Manager or Parameter Store access.

InstanceType.Description: An arm64 (Graviton) family with Nitro Enclaves support and no burst credits.

ImageId.Description: Amazon Linux 2023 for arm64 (it packages aws-nitro-enclaves-cli).

ProxyPort.Description: The one inbound port: the parent proxy.

EnclaveCpuCount.Description: vCPUs set aside for the enclave.

EnclaveMemoryMiB.Description: Memory set aside for the enclave.

EifUrl.Description: Where to fetch seal.eif (the published build).

ProxyUrl.Description: Where to fetch the seal_proxy binary.

MeasurementsUrl.Description: The published enclave/measurements.json at the release commit.

StartMode.Description: genesis only for the very first enclave, once; every other start is join.

PeerAddress.Description: host:port of a running region's proxy, to join from.

GhostNodeAddress.Description: host:port of a Ghost node, for the chain check.

Assertions.AssertDescription: A join needs the PeerAddress of a running region.

Properties.Description: The Seal host: writes its own proxy logs, nothing else. No KMS, S3, Secrets Manager or Parameter Store.

Properties.GroupDescription: The Seal host: the proxy port only, no SSH.

SecurityGroupIngress.Description: The parent proxy (TLS to the enclave, key-share requests).

Fn::Sub:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
dnf install -y aws-nitro-enclaves-cli amazon-cloudwatch-agent
mkdir -p /opt/seal /var/log/seal

# The enclave's CPUs and memory, set aside from the host.
cat > /etc/nitro_enclaves/allocator.yaml <<'ALLOCATOR'
---
memory_mib: ${EnclaveMemoryMiB}
cpu_count: ${EnclaveCpuCount}
ALLOCATOR
systemctl enable --now nitro-enclaves-allocator.service

# The published build, its proxy and the list, each checked against its pinned hash.
fetch() { curl --proto '=https' -fsSL "$1" -o "$2"; echo "$3  $2" | sha256sum -c -; }
fetch '${EifUrl}' /opt/seal/seal.eif '${EifSha256}'
fetch '${ProxyUrl}' /opt/seal/seal_proxy '${ProxySha256}'
fetch '${MeasurementsUrl}' /opt/seal/measurements.json '${MeasurementsSha256}'
chmod 0755 /opt/seal/seal_proxy

# Never in debug mode: a debug enclave reports zero PCRs and is refused everywhere.
nitro-cli run-enclave --eif-path /opt/seal/seal.eif --cpu-count ${EnclaveCpuCount} --memory ${EnclaveMemoryMiB} --enclave-cid ${EnclaveCid}

unit() {
  cat > "/etc/systemd/system/$1.service" <<UNIT
[Unit]
Description=Seal parent proxy ($1)
After=network-online.target
[Service]
ExecStart=/opt/seal/seal_proxy $2
Restart=always
DynamicUser=yes
AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
StandardError=append:/var/log/seal/$1.log
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
}
unit seal-inbound 'inbound 0.0.0.0:${ProxyPort} ${EnclaveCid} 5001'
unit seal-node 'outbound 5003 ${GhostNodeAddress}'
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now seal-inbound seal-node
if [ '${StartMode}' = join ]; then
  unit seal-peer 'outbound 5002 ${PeerAddress}'
  systemctl daemon-reload
  systemctl enable --now seal-peer
fi

cat > /opt/seal/cloudwatch.json <<'AGENT'
{"logs": {"logs_collected": {"files": {"collect_list": [{"file_path": "/var/log/seal/*.log", "log_group_name": "${LogGroup}", "log_stream_name": "{instance_id}"}]}}}}
AGENT
/opt/aws/amazon-cloudwatch-agent/bin/amazon-cloudwatch-agent-ctl -a fetch-config -m ec2 -s -c file:/opt/seal/cloudwatch.json

# The enclave's one start (the mode alone), then the list, which it takes only if the release key signed it.
/opt/seal/seal_proxy start ${EnclaveCid} ${StartMode} /opt/seal/measurements.json 2>> /var/log/seal/start.log

ProxyAddress.Description: host:port of this region's proxy, the PeerAddress for a region that joins from it.
